package.name: visual_query
package.description: Pure C++ local visual-observability query for the TEB local trajectory optimiser: a bounded downsampled map snapshot, a smooth four-factor point weight (w_fov * w_stat * w_dyn(t) * w_rel), query(pose, time) and query_pair(). Read-only with respect to ORB-SLAM: it only consumes a snapshot.
